CustomField.description: Decides who the agent's runs act as. Set: the identity's execution user, through its Named Credential. Blank: whoever starts the run. An identity in use cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Runs as this identity's user, which supports approvals and recovery. A run a person starts is also limited by that person's access. Leave blank to run as whoever starts the agent.
CustomField.label: Agent Execution Identity
